claim.quote: Resulting limits on the spin-independent WIMP-nucleon elastic-scattering cross-section exclude unexplored parameter space for WIMPs with masses between 10-70 GeV c^{-2}.

name: Exclusion limits on the WIMP-nucleon cross-section from the Cryogenic Dark Matter Search

summary.plain: The full CDMS I analysis of its 1998-99 data: twenty-three candidate events were seen, all consistent with neutron background, and the limits ruled out new space for WIMPs of 10 to 70 GeV.
summary.technical: 15.8 kg d on Ge with a relaxed fiducial-volume cut (1998-99 data): 23 WIMP candidates consistent with neutrons; surface-event rejection >95%; limits exclude 10-70 GeV/c^2 and border but do not exclude supersymmetric parameter space.

title: Exclusion limits on the WIMP-nucleon cross-section from the Cryogenic Dark Matter Search
why_it_matters: The definitive CDMS I paper, describing the detectors, the shallow-site neutron background and the limits in detail.
